channel.description: Recent content in Common Lisp on Seojun's Personal Site

item.title: Understanding Equality in Common Lisp
item.description: Learn the key differences between eq, eql, equal, and equalp in Common Lisp. This guide helps you choose the right equality predicate for symbols, numbers, strings, and lists.

item.title: Mastering Loop in Common Lisp: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Learn how to use the powerful `loop` construct in Common Lisp to simplify iteration and control flow. This guide covers fundamental usage with examples.

item.title: Common Lisp Character & String Guide: Comparison, Conversion, and Manipulation
item.description: Learn how to handle characters and strings in Common Lisp with this complete guide. Covers character representation, ASCII conversion, string comparison, substring extraction, number conversion, and various string manipulation techniques with practical examples

item.title: Mastering Conditionals in Common Lisp: when, unless, if, cond
item.description: Learn how to use conditionals in Lisp. This guide covers when, unless, if, and cond statements to control logic flow and return values effectively. Improve code readability and minimize errors by mastering these conditional structures.

item.title: Understanding Variable Assignment in Common Lisp
item.description: Learn how variable assignment works in Common Lisp, including global and local variables, setq, let, and defvar. This practical guide covers key differences from modern languages and best practices for efficient Lisp programming.
